user.title: Laundry Advisor
user.description: Choose the weather entity, load type, and optional local outdoor sensors used to calculate drying conditions.

data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity that provides hourly or daily forecast data.
data_description.forecast_hours: Number of forecast hours to analyze (3-48 hours).
data_description.update_interval: How often to recalculate the laundry advice (5-240 minutes).
data_description.load_type: Fabric weight used to estimate drying duration.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional real-time outdoor temperature sensor to refine the current hour.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional real-time outdoor humidity sensor to refine the current hour.
data_description.wind_speed_sensor: Optional real-time outdoor wind speed sensor to refine the current hour.

abort.already_configured: This weather entity is already configured.
